page.overview:
Who is Hyarmendacil II?

Hyarmendacil II was the twenty-fourth King of Gondor.

Hyarmendacil was the son of King Aldamir and reigned from TA 1540 until TA 1621. Born as Vinyarion, his father Aldamir was slain in a war with the Haradrim in TA 1540 and Vinyarion wished to avenge his death. He accomplished this in TA 1551 by invading Harad and winning a great victory over the Haradrim, proclaiming himself Hyarmendacil II, meaning in Quenya "South-victor" after his famous ancestor from the twelfth century of the Third Age.

He died in TA 1621 after a rule of eighty-one years, at age two hundred thirty and was succeeded by his son Minardil.

Hyarmendacil is a Quenya word meaning "South-victor".
